name: Note taking (manifest note_taking)
plain: Marks an installed app as a note taking app on ChromeOS.
meaning: Appears in the lock screen note chooser.

access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Marks an installed app as a note taking app on ChromeOS.

limits.headline: Can list an installed web app as a note taking choice on ChromeOS
limits.user_action: You install the web app and pick it in your ChromeOS lock screen note settings
can: Appear in the lock screen note chooser
Open a new note from the lock screen once you pick it
cannot: Work on Windows, Mac, Android or iPhone
Appear before you install the app
See your notes in other apps
limits.differs: ChromeOS only. Not on Windows, Mac, Android or iPhone.

story.what_it_is: An installed web app can tell ChromeOS it is a note taking app, for quick notes from the lock screen.

marketing.name: note_taking
marketing.pitch: A setting that marks an installed web app as a note taking app on ChromeOS.

story.for_you: On a Chromebook with a pen you can start a note from the lock screen or the pen menu. The web app opens ready to write. It is quick and feels native.
story.for_makers: Makers of note apps get the same spot as built in apps in the pen menu. It cuts the time to start a note. It is only for installed apps on ChromeOS.

use_cases.example: A web note app opens a blank note when you tap the pen on a Chromebook, even from the lock screen.
A student pulls out a stylus in class and a web note app opens to take notes.
A web sketch app opens for a quick drawing with a pen.
A field worker taps a pen to write a site note in a company web app.
A clinic web app opens a note for a nurse with a stylus.
A web game wiki tool opens a note for a puzzle clue during play.
A person with limited typing uses a stylus to jot notes on a web app.
